delighted.en: I was delighted when I found out I had got the job.
delighted.zh: 得知自己得到这份工作时,我非常高兴。

thrilled.en: My parents were thrilled when I told them I was getting married.
thrilled.zh: 我告诉父母我要结婚时,他们非常激动。

satisfied.en: I'm pretty satisfied with my life in the city at the moment.
satisfied.zh: 我目前对城市生活挺满意的。

content.en: I'm pretty content with my life at the moment, to be honest.
content.zh: 说实话,我对现在的生活挺满足的。

grateful.en: I'm really grateful to my teacher for helping me through that difficult year.
grateful.zh: 我非常感激老师帮我度过了那艰难的一年。

proud.en: I felt so proud when my son won a prize at school.
proud.zh: 我儿子在学校获奖时,我感到非常自豪。

relieved.en: I was so relieved when I finally found my lost passport.
relieved.zh: 我终于找到丢失的护照时,真是松了一口气。

relaxed.en: I always feel relaxed after a long walk in the countryside.
relaxed.zh: 在乡间走了很久之后,我总是感到很放松。

amazed.en: I was amazed by how friendly people were when I visited Japan.
amazed.zh: 我去日本时,对人们的友好感到惊讶。

astonished.en: I was astonished to see how much the town had changed.
astonished.zh: 看到小镇变化这么大,我很震惊。

impressed.en: I was really impressed by the service at that little restaurant.
impressed.zh: 那家小餐馆的服务给我留下了深刻印象。

fascinated.en: I've been fascinated by space ever since I was a little kid.

nostalgic.en: Old songs from my school days always make me feel nostalgic.
nostalgic.zh: 上学时的老歌总让我感到怀旧。

disappointed.en: I was really disappointed when the concert was cancelled at the last minute.
disappointed.zh: 音乐会在最后一刻取消时,我非常失望。

frustrated.en: I get really frustrated when my phone stops working in the middle of a call.
frustrated.zh: 通话时手机突然没反应,我会特别沮丧。

annoyed.en: I get annoyed when people talk loudly on their phones on the train.
annoyed.zh: 有人在火车上大声打电话时,我会很恼火。

embarrassed.en: I felt so embarrassed when I forgot my boss's name at the party.
embarrassed.zh: 在派对上我忘了老板的名字,感到特别尴尬。

nervous.en: I always feel nervous before speaking in front of a large group.
nervous.zh: 在一大群人面前讲话前,我总是很紧张。

anxious.en: I was quite anxious about moving to a new city on my own.
anxious.zh: 一个人搬到新城市,我当时挺焦虑的。

stressed.en: I get really stressed when I have too many deadlines at once.
stressed.zh: 同时有太多截止日期时,我会感到压力特别大。

exhausted.en: I was completely exhausted after the long flight from Sydney.
exhausted.zh: 从悉尼飞了很久之后,我完全筋疲力尽了。

homesick.en: I felt homesick during my first few weeks at university.
homesick.zh: 上大学的头几周,我很想家。

jealous.en: I was a bit jealous when my friend got a much better job.
jealous.zh: 朋友找到一份好得多的工作时,我有点嫉妒。

regret.en: I regret not learning to play an instrument when I was younger.
regret.zh: 我后悔年轻时没有学一门乐器。

appreciate.en: I didn't appreciate my hometown until I moved far away from it.
appreciate.zh: 直到搬到很远的地方,我才懂得欣赏我的家乡。

admire.en: What I admire most about my mum is how calm she stays.
admire.zh: 我最佩服妈妈的一点是她总能保持冷静。

cherish.en: I really cherish the time I spent with my grandparents as a child.
cherish.zh: 我非常珍惜小时候和祖父母一起度过的时光。

be-keen-on.en: I'm not really keen on sports, but I do enjoy watching football.
be-keen-on.zh: 我不太热衷运动,但确实喜欢看足球。

be-fond-of.en: I've always been fond of old films, especially black and white ones.
be-fond-of.zh: 我一直喜欢老电影,特别是黑白片。

be-passionate-about.en: I'm passionate about cooking and try a new recipe every weekend.
be-passionate-about.zh: 我对烹饪充满热情,每个周末都尝试新食谱。

cant-stand-doing-sth.en: I can't stand waiting in long queues, especially when I'm in a hurry.
cant-stand-doing-sth.zh: 我无法忍受排长队,尤其是赶时间的时候。

unforgettable.en: Our trip to the mountains last year was an unforgettable experience.
unforgettable.zh: 去年的山区之旅是一次难忘的经历。

memorable.en: The most memorable meal I've ever had was at a tiny place in Italy.
memorable.zh: 我吃过最难忘的一餐是在意大利的一家小店。

meaningful.en: I think it's more meaningful to give a handmade present than an expensive one.
meaningful.zh: 我觉得送手工礼物比送昂贵的礼物更有意义。

rewarding.en: Teaching young children can be tiring, but it's a really rewarding job.
rewarding.zh: 教幼儿可能很累,但这是一份很有回报的工作。

fulfilling.en: I'd like a fulfilling job, even if the pay isn't very high.
fulfilling.zh: 我想要一份有成就感的工作,即使薪水不是很高。

challenging.en: Learning to drive was challenging at first, but I soon got used to it.
challenging.zh: 学开车一开始很有挑战性,但我很快就适应了。

tedious.en: I find filling in forms really tedious, so I always leave it until last.
tedious.zh: 我觉得填表特别乏味,所以总是留到最后。

monotonous.en: My first job was quite monotonous, doing the same thing every day.
monotonous.zh: 我的第一份工作挺单调的,每天都做同样的事。

sentimental.en: I'm quite sentimental and keep all the cards that friends have given me.
sentimental.zh: 我挺多愁善感的,朋友送的卡片我都留着。

indifferent.en: I'm pretty indifferent to fashion and just wear whatever is clean.
indifferent.zh: 我对时尚挺无所谓的,有什么干净的就穿什么。

desperate.en: I was desperate for a coffee after getting up at five that morning.
desperate.zh: 那天早上五点就起床,我特别想喝杯咖啡。

enjoyable.en: We had a really enjoyable afternoon walking along the river.
enjoyable.zh: 我们沿着河边散步,度过了一个非常愉快的下午。

refreshing.en: It's refreshing to meet people who really listen to what you say.
refreshing.zh: 遇到真正倾听你说话的人,感觉令人耳目一新。

depressing.en: I find the weather in November quite depressing, because it's so dark.
depressing.zh: 我觉得十一月的天气挺让人沮丧的,因为天太暗了。

appealing.en: Working from home sounds appealing, but I'd probably miss my colleagues.
appealing.zh: 在家工作听起来很有吸引力,但我可能会想念同事。

incredible.en: The view from the top of the mountain was absolutely incredible.
incredible.zh: 从山顶看到的景色真是太棒了。

ridiculous.en: It sounds ridiculous, but I still sleep with the same old pillow.
ridiculous.zh: 听起来很可笑,但我现在还枕着那个旧枕头睡觉。

nasty.en: I had a nasty cold last winter and stayed in bed for a week.
nasty.zh: 去年冬天我得了重感冒,在床上躺了一周。

bizarre.en: I had a bizarre dream last night about flying over my old school.
bizarre.zh: 我昨晚做了个怪梦,梦见自己飞过以前的学校。

ashamed.en: I felt ashamed of myself for shouting at my little brother.
ashamed.zh: 我对弟弟大吼之后,感到很羞愧。

furious.en: My dad was furious when someone scratched his new car.
furious.zh: 有人刮花了爸爸的新车,他气坏了。

awful.en: The food at that hotel was awful, so we ate out every night.
awful.zh: 那家酒店的饭菜很糟糕,所以我们每晚都出去吃。

horrible.en: We had horrible weather on holiday, and it rained for a week.
horrible.zh: 我们度假时天气很差,下了一周的雨。

miserable.en: I felt miserable for days after failing that important exam.
miserable.zh: 那场重要的考试没通过后,我难受了好几天。

uncomfortable.en: I feel uncomfortable talking about money with people I don't know well.
uncomfortable.zh: 和不太熟的人谈钱,我觉得不自在。

weird.en: It felt weird going back to my old school after so many years.
weird.zh: 这么多年后回到以前的学校,感觉很奇怪。

terrific.en: We had a terrific time at the beach with all my cousins.
terrific.zh: 我们和所有表亲在海滩玩得开心极了。

fabulous.en: We had a fabulous meal at a tiny restaurant by the sea.
fabulous.zh: 我们在海边一家小餐馆吃了一顿特别棒的饭。

marvellous.en: We had marvellous weather for the whole of our trip to Greece.
marvellous.zh: 我们去希腊的整个旅程天气都好极了。

dreadful.en: I had a dreadful headache and had to leave work early.
dreadful.zh: 我头疼得厉害,不得不提前下班。

gloomy.en: I always feel a bit gloomy when the days get shorter in winter.
gloomy.zh: 冬天白天变短时,我总是有点忧郁。

weary.en: I was so weary after work that I went straight to bed.
weary.zh: 下班后我累极了,直接上床睡觉。

grief.en: It took my mum a long time to get over the grief of losing her dad.
grief.zh: 我妈妈花了很长时间才走出丧父的悲痛。

despair.en: I almost gave up in despair when I couldn't find a job.
despair.zh: 找不到工作时,我几乎绝望得要放弃了。

misery.en: Being stuck in traffic every morning was pure misery for me.
misery.zh: 每天早上堵在路上对我来说简直是痛苦。

dismay.en: To my dismay, I realised that I had left my passport at home.
dismay.zh: 让我沮丧的是,我发现把护照忘在家里了。

disgust.en: I looked at the dirty kitchen in the hostel with disgust.
disgust.zh: 我厌恶地看着旅舍里脏兮兮的厨房。

pathetic.en: I felt a bit pathetic crying at the end of that silly film.
pathetic.zh: 看那部傻乎乎的电影看到结尾哭了,我觉得自己有点可悲。

restless.en: I feel restless if I have to sit in an office all day.
restless.zh: 如果得整天坐在办公室,我会焦躁不安。
